title: Mère et enfant au fichu (Mother and Child with a Shawl)
medium: Offset Lithograph in Colors on Arches paper

events.t: Desemparats, Maternité, Mère et enfant au fichu
events.q: The source pastel — variously titled Desemparats, Maternité, and Mère et enfant au fichu — was made in Barcelona in 1903

events.n: publisher; edition of 60, hand-signed by Picasso
events.q: In 1966, during Picasso's lifetime, the Museo Picasso in Barcelona — home to the greatest collection of his youthful work — published a suite of fine lithographs after these early masterpieces, each hand-signed by Picasso in pencil in an edition of only 60.
